description: Source code for the AndroidPlatform class, which manages Android SDK data and targets within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It includes methods for retrieving SDK instances, parsing SDKs, and platform-specific information.

classes.name: AndroidPlatform
classes.description: Manages Android SDK data and platform targets, providing methods to retrieve and parse SDK instances, and platform-specific information.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an AndroidPlatform instance associated with a Module or Sdk.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an SDK or library to create an AndroidPlatform instance if applicable.

methods.name: getSdkData
methods.description: Returns the AndroidSdkData associated with this platform.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the IAndroidTarget associated with this platform.

methods.name: needToAddAnnotationsJarToClasspath
methods.description: Determines if the annotations JAR should be added to the classpath based on API level.

methods.name: getApiLevel
methods.description: Returns the API level of the Android target.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the AndroidVersion object of the target.

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Looks up the AndroidPlatform for a given Module.
